verdict.rationale: FutureHouse/Edison is a hosted research-agent platform with an API, so publishing an official MCP server is a plausible capability and the axis applies. The evidence shows only a Python client (edison-client), API-key auth, task and chat-session methods, and an llms.txt docs index. Nothing documents an MCP server or MCP endpoint, and the client and llms.txt are adjacent features that earn no credit here.
